name: Clear Destiny stale process
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
podman stop -t 15 upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman rm upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman pod rm -f upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
pids=$(pgrep -f '^python(3)? .*/upload.py --webui 0.0.0.0:12345$' || true)
if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "stale_upload_pids=$pids"; kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; fi
podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d upload-assistant-wastaken
sleep 15
podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:12345/api/health || true)
echo "local_http=$code"
podman logs --since 20s upload-assistant-wastaken 2>&1 | grep -E 'Address already|Web UI server stopped|Shutdown complete' | tail -10 || true
REMOTE
description: Stop Destiny’s container, remove any same-user stale Upload Assistant process, and recreate the service cleanly.
